image_manifest.description: An asset manifest for a stylized 3D rendered scene of four unique racing pterosaurs and a referee at a cliffside takeoff starting line.

assets.name: Header Text
assets.description: Blue and yellow, stylized, irregular 3D block text reading 'RACING PTEROSAURS!' located at the top of the image.

assets.name: Tupandactylus Racer Character
assets.description: A highly colorful Tupandactylus, crouched bipedally just behind the starting line, its distinctive multi-color iridescent head crest held poised and level for launch.

assets.name: Quetzalcoatlus Racer Character
assets.description: A gigantic, slender Quetzalcoatlus, crouched bipedally in the center-left, towering over the others, its massive body ready to uncoil for a powerful sky launch.

assets.name: Cearadactylus Racer Character
assets.description: A more compact Cearadactylus, crouched bipedally on the right, its eyes fixed with intense, competitive focus on the referee's flag.

assets.name: Pterodaustro Referee Character
assets.description: A standing Pterodaustro on the far right, wearing a black and white striped referee shirt and a cap, its specialized filter-beak snout visible, acting as the ref.

assets.name: Checkered Flag Item
assets.description: A black and white checkered finish/start flag on a pole, held high and steady by the Pterodaustro referee.

assets.name: Cliffside Starting Line Environment
assets.description: White painted start lines on the edge of a sheer cliff, with specific markings to guide takeoff direction, and a dust kick-up effect near the launching racers.

assets.name: Vertiginous Cliff/Sky Background Environment
assets.description: A dramatic cliff face descending to a canyon floor where a distant aerial racecourse is visible, under an open, vibrant-blue sky with sparse white clouds.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent lens-flare type logo/watermark located in the bottom-right corner.
